name: Among the Stars
source:
You'll assume the role of the pilot of a starship who does a deal with a mysterious customer. Predictably things happen, and you find yourself in need of help. Things only get more complicated when you run into an angry autocrat, some mysterious cargo, and an old girlfriend. Along the way you'll run into some beautiful ladies in need of your help, and maybe a little love as well. And that's only the beginning. . .

[From [url=https://mcteech.itch.io/among-the-stars]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
你将扮演一名星际飞船驾驶员，与一位神秘客户做了一笔交易。不出所料，事情出了岔子，你发现自己急需帮助。随后，你又碰上一个怒气冲冲的独裁者、一批神秘货物，以及一位前女友，局面愈发复杂。途中，你还会遇见几位美丽的女士，她们需要你的帮助，或许也需要一点爱情。而这一切，仅仅是个开始……

[摘自[url=https://mcteech.itch.io/among-the-stars]itch.io[/url]]
